description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements a logging node that wraps Android's native Log utility. It forwards log messages and optional exception information to the Android system logs and optionally to a next node in a logging chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility to allow flexible logging chain and forwarding of log messages.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log messages will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional exception, then passes the message to the next node in the chain if exists.
